articles.editorial_analysis_zh: 經濟部稱修法影響範圍涵蓋製造業、電力業及醫院、旅館等民生行業，並對營運、民生與能源韌性提出疑慮；這些衝擊屬經濟部的評估。
articles.source_title: 空污法修法10日協商　經部憂衝擊近8千家業者、盼維持現狀
articles.summary_en: According to an RSS summary from 中央社, the legislature plans cross-party talks on amendments to the air pollution law on November 10. The economics ministry said nearly 8,000 businesses, including manufacturers, power providers, hospitals and hotels, would be affected. It warned that rushed changes could harm operations, livelihoods and energy resilience, and urged broader consultation while retaining the current management framework.
articles.summary_zh: 中央社RSS摘要指出，立法院預計11月10日就《空氣污染防制法》修正草案進行朝野黨團協商。經濟部表示，修法將影響製造業、電力業及醫院、旅館等近8千家業者，憂倉促修法衝擊營運、民生與能源韌性，呼籲充分徵詢意見並維持現行管理機制。

articles.title_zh: 空污法修法10日協商　經濟部憂近8千家業者受影響
